# Membership Status

## Summary
Where a loyalty membership stands: Active / Lapsed / Closed. Catalog field at
`cards/loyalty/membership-status-field.gts`, built on the catalog's
`statusField`, so it renders as constrained dropdowns and state pills and
exposes the transition graph to consumers.

## API
- `Active` (green) — in good standing
- `Lapsed` (amber, holds) — renewal missed; recoverable, points frozen by program rules
- `Closed` (slate, terminal, holds) — deliberately ended; reopens only by re-enrolment
- Transitions: Active → Lapsed | Closed; Lapsed → Active | Closed; Closed → Active

## Usage
```ts
import { MembershipStatusField } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/loyalty/membership-status-field';
import { canTransition } from '@cardstack/catalog/fields/status/status';

@field status = contains(MembershipStatusField);
canTransition(MembershipStatusField, account.status, 'Closed');
```
Loyalty Account carries it as `status`; the Credit Points command refuses to
move points on a Closed account.

## Non-goals
Tier is not status — a Lapsed Gold member is still Gold. Renewal dates and
grace periods are the program's schedule, one level up.
